description: This file contains benchmark tests for 128-bit integer operations (division, remainder, multiplication, addition) using the Abseil library's int128 types, including support for intrinsic 128-bit integers if available.

classes.name: UniformIntDistribution128
classes.description: A custom distribution class for generating 128-bit integers, mimicking std::uniform_int_distribution API.

methods.name: MakeRandomEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns a std::mt19937 random engine seeded with multiple entropy sources.

methods.name: GetRandomClass128SampleUniformDivisor
methods.description: Generates a vector of pairs of 128-bit integers with values uniformly distributed, used for division benchmarks.

methods.name: BM_DivideClass128UniformDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark function for dividing pairs of 128-bit integers.

methods.name: BM_RemainderClass128UniformDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark function for computing remainders of pairs of 128-bit integers.

methods.name: GetRandomClass128SampleSmallDivisor
methods.description: Generates a vector of pairs with small divisors for division benchmarks.

methods.name: BM_DivideClass128SmallDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark function for dividing 128-bit integers with small divisors.

methods.name: BM_RemainderClass128SmallDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark function for computing remainders with small divisors.

methods.name: GetRandomClass128Sample
methods.description: Generates a vector of pairs of random 128-bit integers for multiplication and addition benchmarks.

methods.name: BM_MultiplyClass128
methods.description: Benchmark function for multiplying pairs of 128-bit integers.

methods.name: BM_AddClass128
methods.description: Benchmark function for adding pairs of 128-bit integers.

methods.name: GetRandomIntrinsic128SampleUniformDivisor
methods.description: Generates pairs of 128-bit integers using intrinsic support for division benchmarks.

methods.name: BM_DivideIntrinsic128UniformDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark for dividing pairs of 128-bit integers using intrinsic support.

methods.name: BM_RemainderIntrinsic128UniformDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark for computing remainders of pairs of 128-bit integers using intrinsic support.

methods.name: GetRandomIntrinsic128SampleSmallDivisor
methods.description: Generates pairs with small divisors for intrinsic 128-bit division benchmarks.

methods.name: BM_DivideIntrinsic128SmallDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark for dividing 128-bit integers with small divisors using intrinsic support.

methods.name: BM_RemainderIntrinsic128SmallDivisor
methods.description: Benchmark for computing remainders with small divisors using intrinsic support.

methods.name: GetRandomIntrinsic128Sample
methods.description: Generates pairs of random 128-bit integers using intrinsic support.

methods.name: BM_MultiplyIntrinsic128
methods.description: Benchmark for multiplying 128-bit integers using intrinsic support.
